title: A Speech About Recycling
text:
Last week, a student gave a speech about recycling at our school. She began by asking the audience a simple question: how many of us throw away plastic bottles every day? Many people raised their hands. Then she explained why recycling matters for the environment.

She showed a short video about a city that reduced its waste by half. After the video, she asked everyone to bring one empty bottle to school. The speech was short, but it made many students think about their habits. Several teachers said it was the best speech of the year.

questions.text: What question did the student ask the audience at the beginning?
options: How many of us throw away plastic bottles every day?
Who can speak the best English?
When is the school recycling day?

questions.text: What did the student ask everyone to do after the video?
options: Write a letter to the mayor
Bring one empty bottle to school

questions.text: Why did the speech make many students think about their habits?
options: Because it connected recycling with everyday behaviour
Because the teachers gave them homework
Because it was about the city's history

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the speaker?
options: She was a good speaker who engaged the audience
She was a teacher who disliked recycling
She was afraid of the audience
She was visiting the school for the first time

vocabulary.definition: a formal talk given to an audience
the people who listen to a talk, performance or speech
things a person does regularly, often without thinking
the natural world around us, such as air, water and land

paragraph_translations: Минулого тижня учениця виступила з промовою про переробку відходів у нашій школі. Вона почала з простого запитання до аудиторії: скільки з нас щодня викидають пластикові пляшки? Багато людей підняли руки. Потім вона пояснила, чому переробка важлива для довкілля.

Вона показала коротке відео про місто, яке зменшило відходи вдвічі. Після відео вона попросила всіх принести до школи одну порожню пляшку. Промова була короткою, але змусила багатьох учнів задуматися про свої звички. Кілька вчителів сказали, що це була найкраща промова року.
